study: replication: does blend-v2's design beat the logit alone on periods no design choice ever saw?
registered_before: any prediction or score on these periods (the logit25 table was only checked for feature identity on the 2026 long test)
why: the blend's gain (-0.0041 [-0.0067, -0.0018] Brier(1,6,24,48), Jun-Oct 2026) was measured on the same 152 days its design was chosen on (~38 blend variants); the locked holdout gives its first verdict only on 2026-12-01. Complete hourly radar labels (2014-2026) and ECMWF IFS single runs from 2024-03-14 now allow an out-of-period check with ~3x the test days, which also gives later studies more power.

periods.P1_primary: issues 2024-08-12 .. 2025-10-31, valid < 2025-11-01: before every selection period (Part B robustness Nov 2025-Apr 2026, long test Jun-Oct 2026, hackathon Sep-Oct 2026); starts after the IFS archive has all four daily cycles (2024-08-09 18 UTC)
periods.P2_secondary: issues 2025-11-01 .. 2026-05-31, valid < 2026-06-01 (Part B parameters were checked on Nov 2025-Apr 2026, so not selection-free for the decision half)

data: experiments/logit25/inputs/table.parquet (fra.dataset.build on merged IFS backfill+archive, prognosis history+archive, fra.labels.history_labels(gap_rule='confirmed'); identical to data/wf_cache.parquet on the 2026 long test). Before ICON existed (2026-04/05) the consensus features equal ECMWF and Part B uses its IFS-only fallback (DEFAULT_IFS), as it would have live.

arms.logit: production spec (fra.train.fit od25: C 0.03, 4 lead buckets, last 120 days, per-bucket temperature, clean-label mask = the history labels), weekly walk-forward (fra.evalkit folds from the period start, training rows valid + 2 h <= week start)
arms.dec_365: PRIMARY decision arm: fra.decision.DEFAULT trained each week on history-label transitions from the last 365 days known at the week start (h + FUT <= week start); the closest analogue of the champion's 'recent' set (12-17 months of labels at long-test time); rolled out as fra.blend (lag 2: od_now = label of t-2, Part B fra.fcerror.DEFAULT with its IFS fallback, 200 paths, seed 0, ensemble-mean look-ahead)
arms.dec_all: secondary: same, trained on all history transitions since 2014 (the blend-hist12 design)
arms.baselines: published INAA prognosis (base_prognosis_od25) and the official rule (rule_od25) on the same rows

primary: Brier(1,6,24,48) of blend (dec_365) minus logit on P1, paired 1-day-block bootstrap, 2,000 draws, seed 20261106; rows where every arm has a finite prediction
replicates_if: 95 % CI entirely below 0 on P1 AND negative point estimate in both halves of P1 (issue before / from 2025-04-01) AND no lead 1/6/24/48 with a paired accuracy CI entirely below 0
consequence: information for the holdout verdict and for the choice of test period in later studies; nothing live changes
holdout: nothing at or after 2026-06-01 is scored here; nothing at or after 2026-11-01 is read
